notes.title: UPDATE 0.4.4.0
notes.content: [p][b]Balancing:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased execution speed and damage of Bosses and Mini-Bosses attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the health of some Bosses and Mini-Bosses.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the travel speed of the player’s basic attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the player’s movement speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased monster movement speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the percentage bonus of cooldown reduction upgrades when leveling up.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the chance of cooldown reduction upgrades appearing when leveling up.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the cooldown time of many spells, aiming for around 10 seconds maximum, with some exceptions.[/p][/*][*][p]Along with the cooldown changes, spell durations were also adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced the damage of various spells.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the upgrades of certain spells when leveling them up in the spellbook.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed a system that required a certain distance to activate the autocast system (it was confusing some players).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Monsters resistant to negative status effects now display “RESISTANT” when taking damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the tooltip text that appears when unlocking a new spell.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the texts in the upgrade selection screen when leveling up, which were previously blurry.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the upgrade selection screen not being centered when leveling up.[/p][/*][*][p]Added some tips when entering shrine areas that appear randomly during a run.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b][i][u]*Since the demo no longer reflects the current state of the game, it has been disabled.[/u][/i][/b][/p]

notes.content:
[p][b]HOTFIX 0.4.3.1[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug in the Steamdeck, which when a controller was connected it would not detect it correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where upgrading 10 spells to level 9 was not completing the achievement on Steam.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]HOTFIX 0.4.3.2[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed time requirement for finding entrances to some minigames.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.4.3.0
notes.content: [p][b]Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The font size of texts in various parts of the game UI has been increased.[/p][/*][*][p]A health bar has been added above special monsters (Elites and Dachs Minions).[/p][/*][*][p]The player character's speed has been slightly increased.[/p][/*][*][p]It is now possible to exchange 2 universal scrolls of lower rarity for 1 of higher rarity in the scroll exchanger.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479471/acdcd9bf587e5e78faafa7e66a96a12983d04c72.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug on the water boss that would rarely occur causing him to use 2x attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that allowed 2 shrines to spawn in the same place.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where completing the upgrade tree was not completing the achievement on Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual bug that rarely occurred in player statistics.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Dachs Hunter Is Available Now in Early Access!
notes.content: [p]The big day is here! And with no further ado: [b]you can now play Dachs Hunter Early Access[/b] with a 10% launch discount! Check out the Early Access trailer:[/p][previewyoutube="lQR3Z3zgu18;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]Steam reviews: your thoughts matter[/h3][hr][/hr][p]We read ALL Steam reviews. If you've been playing Dachs Hunter and feel like sharing your experience, Steam reviews are especially helpful right now. If you haven’t already, please leave an honest review on our store page, as it helps us out greatly.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for your support, have fun, and see you out there on the battlefield![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for the support![/p]

notes.title: Dachs Hunter will be released on Early Access on June 17th!
notes.content: [p]Hey guys,[/p][p]The portals of Dachs Hunter open on June 17th, and we’re excited to welcome you into battle. The game will officially launch into Early Access at (6 PM GMT-3 / 2 PM PDT / 11 PM CEST)![/p][p][/p][p][b]At launch, Dachs Hunter will be available for $4.99 and will also feature a 10% launch discount for 14 days![/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Characters[/b][/h3][hr][/hr][p]In the early access version you will be able to play with new characters totaling six elements (fire, water, ice, electric, earth and poison).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479471/d1dd2eaf25114727a32e80998d33b8d151d81558.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Available Content[/b][/h3][hr][/hr][list][*][p]6 Maps[/p][/*][*][p]12 Bosses[/p][/*][*][p]60 Spells (10 of each element)[/p][/*][*][p]90+ Achievements[/p][/*][*][p]100+ Unique Enemies[/p][/*][*][p]6 Arcane Tiers (dificulty levels)[/p][/*][*][p]6 Minigames[/p][/*][*][p]Friend's Leaderboard[/p][/*][*][p]Meta Progression (upgrades + spells level)[/p][/*][*][p]Scroll Exchanger[/p][/*][*][p]and more..[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Changes[/b][/h3][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Changed the maximum level of spells from level 4 to 9.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the amount of dachs minion spawns from 2 to 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the opacity of AOE spell indicators.[/p][/*][*][p]Offensive, defensive, and utility upgrades are now offered together upon leveling up.[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrades that appeared when leveling up to 10, 20, 30... are now called arcane traits and are collected by defeating elites and mini bosses.[/p][/*][*][p]The demo will be available for an additional 14 days after the early access launch.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest kicks off!
notes.content: [p]Hello guys,[/p][p]We will be participating in the Steam Next Fest's June 2025 edition![/p][p]We have a new version that includes several bug fixes, improvements, new features like scroll exchanger, the ability to see statistics while playing, change the map difficulty and much more...[/p][p]If you have played old versions, it is worth testing again. And to new players, welcome and we hope you enjoy our game![/p][p]If you have any suggestions, or find any bugs, feel free to contact us![/p]

notes.content: [p][b]Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a visual error where when the player had no scrolls, the Poison Scroll spell would appear in the hints;[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the way to select upgrades when leveling up. Now it is necessary to double-click or press 'enter'.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the Sprites of some enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Change the icon of the "Shrine" that grants attack bonus on the minimap.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual improvement in the effect of healing enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]The basic attack now appears with the name "Basic Attack" when selecting upgrades when leveling up.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error where healing potions followed the player even with full health.[/p][/*][*][p]It is now possible to see the player's statistics by pressing "tab".[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479471/4c30cc4141b185fc7a0e28396895bcecb1ca8c8c.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.3.1.0
notes.content:
[b]Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Dash damage is now counted on the stats screen.
[*] New "Arcane Tier" difficulty system. Now it is possible for the player to choose the difficulty they want to play the map on, but they must unlock it first.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would not pause when opening the Steam Overlay using a controller.
[*] Added a notice to the start menu warning that game progress will migrate to the early access version.
[/list]

[b]New Scroll Exchange System:[/b]
[list]
[*] Allows you to exchange two scrolls of a rarity for a universal scroll, allowing you to use it when upgrading any spell of the same rarity. (ex: 2x Poison Cloud Scrolls => 1x Common Universal Scroll).
[/list]
[previewyoutube=oDs6Mi2d1W4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.3.0.0
notes.content:
[b]Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Music volume slightly reduced during Boss battles.
[*] Added a message on the main menu informing until when the demo will be available.
[*] The Friends Leaderboard, which previously appeared when entering the portal, has now been moved to the board inside the portal room.
[*] A menu showing the map difficulty is now displayed when entering a portal.
[*] Added sound effects to some menus that previously had no sound.
[*] Fixed a minor bug on the minimap.
[*] Fixed a bug in the spellbook.
[*] Added an option to reset game progress to the settings menu.
[*] Added a new HUD to the settings menu.
[/list]

[b]Balancing:[/b]

[list]
[*] Some area-of-effect (AOE) spells no longer follow the player.
[*] Adjusted the area size of certain spells.
[*] Significantly reduced the cooldown time of several spells.
[*] Increased the cooldown reduction limit of several spells to 85%, with only some remaining at 50% due to their mechanics.
[*] Adjusted the damage of certain spells.
[*] Map difficulty now varies based on the required magic power, and this information is shown when entering a portal.
[*] Healing potions now spawn randomly across the map.
[*] The HP of various monsters has been reduced, especially elites and bosses.
[*] Damage and attack patterns of some bosses have been modified.
[*] Special monsters (explosive, ranged, etc.) now appear randomly in small numbers instead of in waves.
[*] It is now possible to obtain upgrades to improve the basic attack.
[*] Upgrades have been divided into two groups: one for offensive improvements and another for defensive and utility upgrades.
[/list]

[b]The Friends Leaderboard has now been moved to the board inside the portal room:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479471/317ed5bb6af9af6391101f08a02409ca3e999a2d.png[/img]

[b]Map difficulty menu when entering a portal:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479471/b7be912e4cc47110df6c21b196c10bdadfd1fbfa.png[/img]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.2.0.0
notes.content:
This update contains bug fixes, balancing, new upgrades, and more.

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Small improvement to the spell autocasting system. (Now with the autocast system the AOE spells only activate if enemies are close to a certain distance).
[*] The cooldown time of some spells has been slightly changed.
[*] Fire Breath spell now attacks in the mouse direction.
[*] Improved the sprite of the Fire Breath spell.
[*] Changed the sprite of the Flamethrower spell.
[*] Increased the number of elite monsters.
[*] Elite monsters now have more health and use special attacks.
[*] Characters now unlock by killing the first elite on the map of the same element instead of the mini boss.
[*] The inventory chest has been temporarily disabled.
[*] An improvement to the loot drop indicator has been made.
[/list]

[h3]We've added some map events "Shrines" that appear randomly and grant bonuses.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479471/2e2d29f4cb8c7e3d09dda90779cb51c4f61d20ca.png[/img]

[h3]We've revamped the upgrade system:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479471/c2341fdb8fd9dafbf7dbf1d02c756faec39d0218.png[/img]

[b]Upgrade System:[/b]
[list]
[*] A visual improvement was made in the selection of upgrades when leveling up.
[*] The base percentage for some upgrades has been changed.
[*] Now there is a rarity system for the upgrades.
[*] Offensive upgrades are now individual for each spell.
[*] New special upgrades have been added that appear every 10 levels.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the font of some numbers displayed on the screen.
[*] Fixed the luck upgrades to now show as a percentage.
[*] Fixed a SFX glitch in the upgrade menu.
[*] Fixed a glitch in basic attack SFX.
[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: Welcome!
notes.content:
Hello everyone

Thanks for checking out our first game Dachs Hunter.

The game has been in development for about a year now, and we want to start sharing more information with you!

We released our first trailer this month. We can't wait to hear what you think of Dachs Hunter!
